headline: D-St set for a negative opening as GIFT Nifty signals weak start
summary: The Nifty 50 closed down 35.75 points at 24,435.95 on August 12 amid higher crude costs. Foreign investors sold shares worth Rs 1,002.50 crore, and the rupee traded near 95.32 per dollar.
why: The Nifty 50 is India's benchmark index of 50 large companies, and crude prices and the rupee are key drivers of Indian equity flows.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: The benchmark index closed lower amid investor unease over higher crude costs.
